from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityClassData(BaseModel):
    """Class section statistics for one university from a single CDS document."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    total_undergraduate_class_sections: int | None = Field(description="Total number of undergraduate class sections")
    large_class_sections_100_plus: int | None = Field(description="Number of class sections with 100 or more students")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_class_data: list[UniversityClassData]
